provenance.command: cd apps/mobile && MINDWTR_CAPTURE_SETTINGS_SCREENS=1 TZ=UTC bunx vitest run components/settings/settings.parity.test.tsx
provenance.sourceState: Every file under apps/ was at HEAD except this harness. packages/core held the new settings models and contract block, which no React Native code imported yet.
provenance.device: The device is stubbed: navigator.language and Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().locale are the scenario systemLocale, and Date.prototype.toLocaleDateString is core's System short date (createDateFormatter with dateFormat system) for that locale and the stored settings.

recaptured.command: cd apps/mobile && TZ=UTC bunx vitest run components/settings/settings.parity.test.tsx, with the React Native settings fixes in place; only the observations below were replaced
observations: general: theme picker, the last pick (the stored theme again): no settings write. Its 'repeat' marker is gone: React Native and the native host both skip a write that changes nothing.
manage: every people row: a count of one reads '1 task' ('1 Aufgabe' in German), and a person with no note or link shows the count once, beside the row.
manage: unassigned color and new areas, the new area 'home' while 'Home' exists: Save is off, so the editor stays open and nothing is written (it used to add nothing and recolor 'Home' grey).

recaptured.command: cd apps/mobile && MINDWTR_DUMP_SETTINGS_SCREENS=<file> TZ=UTC bunx vitest run components/settings/settings.parity.test.tsx, with the React Native accessibility fixes in place; only the observations below were replaced, and every other observation matched the frozen one
observations: manage: every scenario that shows Areas, Contexts or Tags open (stored open sections, unreadable stored sections, toggling sections, unassigned color and new areas, editing areas, deleting an area, contexts and tags, empty lists, in German): only the accessibility labels changed. The pencil and trash buttons now name their item, 'Edit: <name>' and 'Delete: <name>' ('Bearbeiten: …' and 'Löschen: …' in German), and the unassigned row's pencil reads 'Edit: Unassigned'. Texts, writes, device writes and alerts are unchanged.
The section headers now carry a button role and their open state, and the General pickers' options a radio role and their chosen state; this fixture records neither, so no other observation changed.

recaptured.command: MINDWTR_DUMP_SETTINGS_SCREENS=<task-log>/settings-observations.json rtk bun run --cwd apps/mobile test components/settings/settings.parity.test.tsx; replaced only Manage texts and labels for the new explicit context/tag create affordances
observations: Manage sections for Contexts and Tags append a New context/New tag label and Add button when open (localized in German). Frozen inputs, actions, writes, alerts, device writes and editor fields are unchanged.

recaptured.command: cd apps/mobile && MINDWTR_DUMP_SETTINGS_SCREENS=<file> TZ=UTC bunx vitest run components/settings/settings.parity.test.tsx, with the App Lock relock delay row in place (#1423); only the observations below were replaced, and every other observation matched the frozen one
observations: general: stored values, task age and quick access, in German, and app lock after the successful enable: while App Lock is on, a 'Require unlock' row ('Entsperren verlangen' in German) showing 'Immediately' ('Sofort') follows the App lock row. Only texts changed.

general: app lock relock delay is a new scenario: the picker offers Immediately, After 1 minute, After 5 minutes and After 15 minutes; picking 5 minutes writes security.mobileAppLockRelockDelayMinutes 5 with App Lock kept on, and picking it again writes nothing.
